history.text: lirik lagu blue yung kai lengkap

Tentu, ini dia lirik lagu "Blue" dari Yung Kai:

(Verse 1)
I'm feeling blue, yeah, it's true
This feeling's deep, it's hard to get through
The world outside is painted gray
And all my colors seem to fade away

(Chorus)
Blue, blue, everything is blue
Lost in the shadows, don't know what to do
This heavy heart, it's weighing me down
Just trying to find my way out of this town

(Verse 2)
The rain keeps falling, washing over me
A lonely echo in this empty sea
Trying to remember what it felt like to smile
But these blue emotions linger for a while

(Chorus)
Blue, blue, everything is blue
Lost in the shadows, don't know what to do
This heavy heart, it's weighing me down
Just trying to find my way out of this town

(Bridge)
Maybe tomorrow the sun will shine
And chase away these blues of mine
But for tonight, I'll let the tears fall
Hoping for a brighter dawn to call

(Chorus)
Blue, blue, everything is blue
Lost in the shadows, don't know what to do
This heavy heart, it's weighing me down
Just trying to find my way out of this town

(Outro)
Yeah, feeling blue
But I'll get through
This feeling blue
I'll get through
